milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to visually locate/observe a grass_block. The grass_block ground is at [0, -1, 0] (directly below spawn). The player needs to look downward toward the ground to 'find' it. A generous max_distance of 5 and facing_tolerance of 90 degrees accounts for the fact that grass is everywhere underfoot — the player just needs to look down anywhere near spawn.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to visually locate/observe the pumpkin patch. The pumpkin patch center is at [6, 0, 5] (spawn-relative). The player must navigate toward the pumpkins and face them. max_distance=8 allows the player to see the pumpkins from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at the patch.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the task is to visually locate/observe the wheat field. The wheat field center is at [-6, 0, 5] (spawn-relative). The player must navigate toward the wheat and face it. max_distance=8 allows the player to see the wheat from a reasonable distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at the field.
